name: 計算演習 Area III（旧初見模試）
topic: 計算演習 Area III（旧初見模試）

questions.subtopic: Statement of Activities — Net (Expense) Revenue of a Function
questions.stem:
The City of Harlow reports the following for its public safety function for the year ended June 30, Year 3:
Public safety expenses | $8,400,000
Traffic fines and court fees | $350,000
State grant restricted to police training programs | $600,000
Federal grant restricted to the purchase of fire engines | $900,000
Property taxes levied by ordinance specifically for public safety | $2,000,000
Unrestricted state aid that the city chose to allocate to public safety | $400,000
What amount should the city report as net (expense) revenue for the public safety function in its government-wide statement of activities?
questions.explanation: Program revenues are deducted from the function's expenses. They consist of charges for services (fines and court fees of $350,000), operating grants and contributions restricted to the function ($600,000), and capital grants and contributions restricted to the function ($900,000). Total program revenues are $1,850,000, so net (expense) revenue is $8,400,000 - $1,850,000 = $(6,550,000). All taxes, including taxes levied for a specific purpose, are general revenues, and unrestricted state aid is also a general revenue even if management allocates it internally; both are reported below the net (expense) revenue section. The $(4,550,000) answer deducts the earmarked property taxes, and the $(4,150,000) answer also deducts the unrestricted state aid. The $(7,450,000) answer omits the capital grant, which is a program revenue in its own column.
questions.explanationJa: 機能別の費用から差し引くのはプログラム収益のみである。プログラム収益は、サービス対価（罰金・裁判手数料 $350,000）、当該機能に使途が限定された運営補助金（$600,000）、当該機能に使途が限定された資本補助金（$900,000）の3区分で、合計 $1,850,000。したがって純（費用）収益は $8,400,000 − $1,850,000 = $(6,550,000) となる。税金は特定目的のために課税されたものでも全て一般収益であり、使途制限のない州補助金も、経営者が内部的に配分していても一般収益として純（費用）収益の下に表示する。$(4,550,000) は目的税の固定資産税を差し引いた誤り、$(4,150,000) はさらに使途制限のない州補助金まで差し引いた誤りである。$(7,450,000) は、独立の列で表示されるプログラム収益である資本補助金を除外した誤りである。

questions.subtopic: Statement of Activities — Total General Revenues
questions.stem:
The County of Merritt reports the following inflows for its governmental activities for the year:
Property taxes | $6,000,000
Sales taxes that state law restricts to road maintenance | $1,200,000
State shared revenue with no restrictions on use | $800,000
Earnings on a permanent fund whose income must be used for the county library program | $150,000
Unrestricted investment earnings | $220,000
Building permit fees | $400,000
Private contributions restricted to construction of park facilities | $500,000
What amount should the county report as total general revenues in its government-wide statement of activities?
questions.explanation: General revenues are property taxes ($6,000,000), the restricted sales taxes ($1,200,000), unrestricted state shared revenue ($800,000), and unrestricted investment earnings ($220,000), for a total of $8,220,000. All taxes are general revenues even when they are restricted to a particular purpose, because they are imposed on the citizenry as a whole rather than on the users of a program. Earnings on endowments or permanent fund investments that are restricted to a specific program are program revenues (operating grants and contributions) of that program. Building permit fees are charges for services, and the restricted park contributions are capital grants and contributions; both are program revenues. The $7,020,000 answer excludes the restricted sales taxes, the $8,370,000 answer adds the library permanent fund earnings, and the $7,420,000 answer treats the unrestricted state shared revenue as a program grant.
questions.explanationJa: 一般収益は、固定資産税 $6,000,000、使途制限付き売上税 $1,200,000、使途制限のない州配分収益 $800,000、使途制限のない投資収益 $220,000 の合計 $8,220,000 である。税金はプログラムの利用者ではなく住民全体に課されるため、特定目的に制限されていても全て一般収益となる。特定プログラムへの使用が求められる基金・永久基金の運用益は、そのプログラムのプログラム収益（運営補助金・寄付）である。建築許可手数料はサービス対価、公園施設建設に制限された寄付は資本補助金・寄付であり、いずれもプログラム収益である。$7,020,000 は使途制限付き売上税を除外した誤り、$8,370,000 は図書館の永久基金運用益を加えた誤り、$7,420,000 は使途制限のない州配分収益をプログラム補助金とみなした誤りである。

questions.subtopic: Net Investment in Capital Assets — Premium, Refunding Deferral and Non-Capital Debt
questions.stem:
The City of Norcross provides the following information for its governmental activities at December 31, Year 6:
Capital assets, net of accumulated depreciation | $48,000,000
General obligation bonds payable, all issued to finance capital construction | $18,000,000
Unamortized premium on the general obligation bonds | $600,000
Unspent proceeds of the general obligation bonds held in the capital projects fund | $3,000,000
Deferred outflow of resources from a loss on refunding of capital-related bonds | $400,000
Construction contracts payable (retainage) | $500,000
Pension obligation bonds payable | $2,000,000
What amount should the city report as net investment in capital assets in its government-wide statement of net position?
questions.explanation: Net investment in capital assets equals capital assets net of depreciation, reduced by the outstanding debt (including unamortized premium) and other liabilities attributable to acquiring or constructing those assets, and adjusted for related deferred outflows and inflows. The capital-related portion of the bonds excludes the $3,000,000 of unspent proceeds, which are not yet invested in capital assets: $18,000,000 + $600,000 - $3,000,000 = $15,600,000. Net investment in capital assets = $48,000,000 - $15,600,000 - $500,000 retainage + $400,000 deferred outflow = $32,300,000. The $29,300,000 answer fails to exclude the unspent bond proceeds. The $30,300,000 answer deducts the pension obligation bonds, which did not finance capital assets and affect unrestricted net position instead. The $31,500,000 answer subtracts the deferred outflow from the refunding instead of adding it.
questions.explanationJa: 資本資産純投資額は、減価償却累計額控除後の資本資産から、その取得・建設に起因する未償還債務（未償却プレミアムを含む）とその他の負債を控除し、関連する繰延資源流出・流入を加減して求める。債券のうち未使用の調達資金 $3,000,000 はまだ資本資産に投資されていないため、資本関連債務から除く。$18,000,000 + $600,000 − $3,000,000 = $15,600,000。資本資産純投資額 = $48,000,000 − $15,600,000 − 留保金 $500,000 + 繰延資源流出 $400,000 = $32,300,000。$29,300,000 は未使用の債券調達資金を除かなかった誤りである。$30,300,000 は年金債を控除した誤りで、年金債は資本資産の財源ではないため制限なし純資産に影響する。$31,500,000 は借換損失による繰延資源流出を加算せず減算した誤りである。

questions.subtopic: Restricted Net Position — Netting Related Liabilities
questions.stem:
The Town of Pell provides the following information for its governmental activities at year-end:
Permanent fund principal that must be maintained intact, with income used for cemetery care | $3,000,000
Accumulated, unspent permanent fund earnings available for cemetery care | $250,000
Debt service fund assets accumulated under bond covenants | $900,000
Accrued interest payable on those bonds, to be paid from the debt service fund assets | $120,000
Cash received from a federal grantor in advance of incurring allowable costs, with an equal unearned revenue liability | $400,000
General Fund resources that the town council set aside by ordinance for a revenue stabilization reserve | $1,500,000
What total amount should the town report as restricted net position in its government-wide statement of net position?
questions.explanation: Restricted net position is restricted assets reduced by the liabilities and deferred inflows related to those assets. The permanent fund contributes $3,250,000 (the $3,000,000 nonexpendable principal plus the $250,000 expendable earnings, both externally restricted). The debt service resources contribute $900,000 - $120,000 = $780,000. The advance grant cash is offset entirely by the unearned revenue liability, so it contributes nothing. The council's stabilization reserve is a constraint imposed by the government itself rather than by external parties or enabling legislation, so it is unrestricted net position. Total restricted net position = $3,250,000 + $780,000 = $4,030,000. The $5,530,000 answer includes the council-designated reserve. The $4,150,000 answer fails to deduct the accrued interest payable from the debt service assets. The $4,430,000 answer includes the advance grant cash without netting the related liability.
questions.explanationJa: 制限付き純資産は、制限付き資産からそれに関連する負債・繰延資源流入を控除した額である。永久基金は、維持が求められる元本 $3,000,000（非消費可能）と使用可能な運用益 $250,000 がともに外部制限であり $3,250,000。債務返済資源は $900,000 − $120,000 = $780,000。前受けの補助金現金は同額の前受収益（負債）と相殺されるため 0。議会の条例による財政安定化準備は、外部当事者や授権立法ではなく政府自身が課した制約であるため制限なし純資産となる。制限付き純資産合計 = $3,250,000 + $780,000 = $4,030,000。$5,530,000 は議会指定の準備を含めた誤り、$4,150,000 は債務返済資産から未払利息を控除しなかった誤り、$4,430,000 は前受け補助金現金を関連負債と相殺せずに含めた誤りである。

questions.subtopic: Reconciliation — Total Fund Balances to Net Position of Governmental Activities
questions.stem:
The City of Quinlan reports total fund balances of $6,500,000 in its governmental funds balance sheet at June 30, Year 4. The following additional information is available:
Capital assets used in governmental activities, net of accumulated depreciation | $40,000,000
General obligation bonds payable | $15,000,000
Interest accrued on the bonds since the last payment date (not yet due) | $200,000
Property taxes reported as deferred inflows of resources (unavailable revenue) in the governmental funds | $700,000
Long-term portion of compensated absences | $900,000
Net position of an internal service fund that serves only governmental departments | $1,100,000
What amount should the city report as net position of governmental activities in its government-wide statement of net position?
questions.explanation: Starting from total governmental fund balances of $6,500,000: add capital assets of $40,000,000, which are not current financial resources; subtract the bonds of $15,000,000, the accrued interest of $200,000, and the long-term compensated absences of $900,000, which are not due and payable from current resources and so are not reported in the funds; add back the $700,000 of unavailable property tax revenue, which is revenue under the accrual basis; and add the $1,100,000 internal service fund net position because the fund primarily serves governmental activities. Net position = $6,500,000 + $40,000,000 - $15,000,000 - $200,000 + $700,000 - $900,000 + $1,100,000 = $32,200,000. The $30,800,000 answer subtracts the unavailable revenue instead of adding it. The $31,100,000 answer omits the internal service fund. The $33,300,000 answer omits the accrued interest and compensated absences on the assumption that the funds already report them.
questions.explanationJa: 政府ファンドのファンド残高合計 $6,500,000 を出発点とする。当期の財務資源ではない資本資産 $40,000,000 を加算し、当期資源から支払期限が到来しないためファンドに計上されない債券 $15,000,000、未払利息 $200,000、有給休暇の長期部分 $900,000 を控除する。発生主義では収益となる未実現（利用不能）固定資産税 $700,000 を加算し、主に政府活動にサービスを提供する内部サービス基金の純資産 $1,100,000 を加算する。純資産 = $6,500,000 + $40,000,000 − $15,000,000 − $200,000 + $700,000 − $900,000 + $1,100,000 = $32,200,000。$30,800,000 は利用不能収益を加算せず減算した誤り、$31,100,000 は内部サービス基金を含めなかった誤り、$33,300,000 は未払利息と有給休暇がファンドで既に計上済みと考えて控除しなかった誤りである。

questions.subtopic: Reconciliation — Net Change in Fund Balances to Change in Net Position
questions.stem:
The City of Radley reports a net change in total governmental fund balances of $2,400,000 for the year. The following also relate to governmental activities for the year:
Capital outlay expenditures, all capitalizable | $6,000,000
Depreciation expense | $2,200,000
Proceeds of general obligation bonds issued at par | $5,000,000
Principal repaid on general obligation bonds | $1,500,000
Cash proceeds from the sale of equipment with a book value of $300,000, reported as an other financing source in the General Fund | $450,000
Increase in property taxes reported as deferred inflows of resources (unavailable revenue) in the governmental funds | $250,000
Change in net position of an internal service fund that serves only governmental departments | $120,000
What amount should the city report as the change in net position of governmental activities?
questions.explanation: Change in net position = $2,400,000 + $6,000,000 capital outlay (capitalized rather than expensed) - $2,200,000 depreciation - $5,000,000 bond proceeds (a liability, not a resource inflow, under the economic resources focus) + $1,500,000 principal repayment (reduces a liability, not an expense) - $300,000 book value of equipment sold + $250,000 increase in unavailable revenue (revenue under accrual) + $120,000 internal service fund change = $2,770,000. The equipment sale is reported in the fund as the full $450,000 of proceeds, but the government-wide statements report only the $150,000 gain, so the reconciling item is the $300,000 book value. The $3,070,000 answer ignores the sale adjustment. The $2,620,000 answer deducts the $450,000 proceeds rather than the $300,000 book value. The $2,270,000 answer subtracts the increase in unavailable revenue instead of adding it.
questions.explanationJa: 純資産の変動額 = $2,400,000 + 資本的支出 $6,000,000（費用ではなく資産計上）− 減価償却費 $2,200,000 − 債券発行収入 $5,000,000（経済的資源測定では資源の流入ではなく負債）+ 元本返済 $1,500,000（費用ではなく負債の減少）− 売却設備の簿価 $300,000 + 利用不能収益の増加 $250,000（発生主義では収益）+ 内部サービス基金の変動 $120,000 = $2,770,000。設備売却はファンドでは売却代金 $450,000 全額がその他の財源となるが、政府全体の財務諸表では売却益 $150,000 のみを計上するため、調整項目は簿価 $300,000 となる。$3,070,000 は売却の調整を行わなかった誤り、$2,620,000 は簿価 $300,000 ではなく売却代金 $450,000 を控除した誤り、$2,270,000 は利用不能収益の増加を加算せず減算した誤りである。

questions.subtopic: ACFR Structure — Placement of MD&A
questions.stem: A state government is preparing its annual comprehensive financial report (ACFR). Where in the ACFR should management's discussion and analysis (MD&A) be presented?

choices.label: A
choices.text: In the introductory section, following the letter of transmittal

choices.label: B
choices.text: In the financial section, immediately before the basic financial statements

choices.label: C
choices.text: In the statistical section, as part of the financial trend information

choices.label: D
choices.text: In the financial section, after the notes to the financial statements together with the other required supplementary information

questions.explanation: The ACFR has three sections: introductory, financial, and statistical. MD&A is required supplementary information, but unlike other RSI it is presented in the financial section before the basic financial statements, following the auditor's report. The letter of transmittal in the introductory section is a separate, unaudited communication and does not replace MD&A. The statistical section contains multi-year trend, revenue capacity, debt capacity, demographic, and operating information, not MD&A. Other RSI, such as budgetary comparison schedules and pension schedules, follows the notes, but MD&A is the exception that precedes the basic financial statements.
questions.explanationJa: ACFRは導入部、財務部、統計部の3部で構成される。MD&Aは必須補足情報（RSI）だが、他のRSIと異なり、財務部の中で監査報告書の後、基本財務諸表の前に表示する。導入部の送付状は監査対象外の別個の文書であり、MD&Aに代わるものではない。統計部には複数年の推移、歳入能力、債務能力、人口統計、業務情報が含まれ、MD&Aは含まれない。予算比較表や年金関連の表など他のRSIは注記の後に表示されるが、MD&Aは基本財務諸表の前に置かれる例外である。

questions.subtopic: Required Supplementary Information — Identification
questions.stem: Which of the following is NOT required supplementary information (RSI) for a city that prepares an ACFR in accordance with GASB standards?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Management's discussion and analysis

choices.label: B
choices.text: A budgetary comparison schedule for the General Fund

choices.label: C
choices.text: A schedule of changes in the net pension liability for a single-employer defined benefit plan

choices.label: D
choices.text: Combining statements for the nonmajor governmental funds

questions.explanation: Combining statements for nonmajor funds are supplementary information presented in the financial section of the ACFR; they are not RSI and are not part of the minimum reporting requirements. MD&A, budgetary comparison schedules for the General Fund and major special revenue funds with legally adopted budgets (when not presented as a basic statement), and the pension schedules required by GASB 68 are all RSI.
questions.explanationJa: 非主要ファンドの結合財務諸表はACFRの財務部に表示される補足情報であり、RSIではなく、最低限の報告要件にも含まれない。MD&A、法的に予算が採択された一般基金と主要特別収入基金の予算比較表（基本財務諸表として表示しない場合）、GASB 68 が求める年金関連の表は、いずれもRSIである。

questions.subtopic: Component Units — Total Primary Government Column
questions.stem:
The City of Sutton reports the following net position amounts at year-end:
Governmental activities of the city's own governmental funds and internal service funds | $50,000,000
Public building authority (legally separate; provides services entirely to the city; blended component unit) | $4,000,000
Business-type activities (water and sewer enterprise funds) | $20,000,000
Housing authority (legally separate; discretely presented component unit) | $7,000,000
Employee pension trust fund | $30,000,000
What amount should the city report in the Total column for the primary government in its government-wide statement of net position?
questions.explanation: A blended component unit is reported as if it were part of the primary government, so the building authority's $4,000,000 is included in governmental activities. The primary government total is $50,000,000 + $4,000,000 + $20,000,000 = $74,000,000. A discretely presented component unit is reported in a separate column to the right of the primary government total, so the housing authority's $7,000,000 is excluded from that total. Fiduciary activities, including pension trust funds, are excluded from the government-wide statements entirely. The $81,000,000 answer adds the discretely presented unit, the $70,000,000 answer leaves out the blended unit, and the $104,000,000 answer adds the pension trust fund.
questions.explanationJa: 混合（ブレンド）表示の構成単位は主たる政府の一部として報告されるため、公共建物公社の $4,000,000 は政府活動に含まれる。主たる政府合計は $50,000,000 + $4,000,000 + $20,000,000 = $74,000,000。個別表示の構成単位は主たる政府合計の右側の別列に表示されるため、住宅公社の $7,000,000 は合計に含めない。年金信託基金を含む受託活動は政府全体の財務諸表から全て除外される。$81,000,000 は個別表示の構成単位を加えた誤り、$70,000,000 はブレンド構成単位を除いた誤り、$104,000,000 は年金信託基金を加えた誤りである。

questions.subtopic: Statement of Activities — Net (Expense) Revenue of the Primary Government
questions.stem:
The City of Tarrant's statement of activities includes the following functions and programs (in thousands):
Function | Expenses | Charges for Services | Operating Grants | Capital Grants
General government | $3,000 | $400 | $0 | $0
Public safety | $7,000 | $0 | $500 | $0
Highways and streets | $4,000 | $0 | $0 | $1,200
Interest on long-term debt | $600 | $0 | $0 | $0
Water utility (business-type) | $5,000 | $5,600 | $0 | $0
What amount should the city report as total net (expense) revenue for the primary government (in thousands)?
questions.explanation: Net (expense) revenue for each function is expenses less program revenues. Governmental activities: general government $(2,600), public safety $(6,500), highways and streets $(2,800), interest on long-term debt $(600), for a total of $(12,500). Business-type activities: water utility $5,600 - $5,000 = $600 of net revenue. Total for the primary government = $(12,500) + $600 = $(11,900). The $(12,500) answer reports only the governmental activities column. The $(13,100) answer treats the water utility's net revenue as a net expense. The $(11,300) answer drops interest on long-term debt, which is reported as a separate line in the expense section of the statement of activities.
questions.explanationJa: 各機能の純（費用）収益は、費用からプログラム収益を差し引いた額である（単位：千ドル）。政府活動は、一般行政 $(2,600)、公共安全 $(6,500)、道路 $(2,800)、長期債務利息 $(600) で合計 $(12,500)。事業型活動は、水道 $5,600 − $5,000 = $600 の純収益。主たる政府合計 = $(12,500) + $600 = $(11,900)。$(12,500) は政府活動の列のみを報告した誤り、$(13,100) は水道の純収益を純費用として扱った誤りである。$(11,300) は長期債務利息を除外した誤りで、長期債務利息は活動計算書の費用欄に独立した行として表示される。

questions.subtopic: Statement of Activities — Charges for Services
questions.stem: In a city's government-wide statement of activities, which of the following should be reported as charges for services?

choices.label: A
choices.text: State shared revenue that the city may use for any purpose

choices.label: B
choices.text: Property taxes that a voter referendum earmarked for parks

choices.label: C
choices.text: Investment earnings that are not restricted to any program

choices.label: D
choices.text: Business license fees

questions.explanation: Charges for services include fees for goods and services, fines and forfeitures, special assessments, and licenses and permits, because they are paid by those who directly benefit from or are directly affected by a program. Business license fees are therefore charges for services, a category of program revenue. Unrestricted state shared revenue and unrestricted investment earnings are general revenues. Property taxes are always general revenues, even when they are earmarked for a specific purpose.
questions.explanationJa: サービス対価には、財・サービスの料金、罰金・没収金、特別賦課金、免許・許可手数料が含まれる。いずれもプログラムから直接便益を受ける者、または直接影響を受ける者が負担するためである。したがって営業許可手数料はプログラム収益の一区分であるサービス対価となる。使途自由の州配分収益と使途制限のない投資収益は一般収益である。固定資産税は特定目的に充てると定められていても常に一般収益である。

questions.subtopic: Reconciliation — Reimbursement Grant Revenue Timing
questions.stem: The City of Upton's fiscal year ends December 31, and the city considers revenues available if they are collected within 60 days after year-end. During Year 2, the city's special revenue fund incurred $1,300,000 of allowable costs under a state reimbursement grant, which is the only eligibility requirement. The state reimbursed $900,000 during Year 2 and $250,000 on February 10, Year 3. The remaining $150,000 is expected to be received in September, Year 3. What amounts of grant revenue should be reported for Year 2 in the special revenue fund and in the governmental activities column of the statement of activities?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Special revenue fund $900,000; governmental activities $1,300,000

choices.label: B
choices.text: Special revenue fund $1,150,000; governmental activities $1,300,000

choices.label: C
choices.text: Special revenue fund $1,150,000; governmental activities $1,150,000

choices.label: D
choices.text: Special revenue fund $1,300,000; governmental activities $1,300,000

questions.explanation: For a reimbursement grant, the eligibility requirement is met when allowable costs are incurred, so under the accrual basis the governmental activities column recognizes the full $1,300,000. Under the modified accrual basis, the fund also requires that the resources be available. The $900,000 collected during the year and the $250,000 collected within 60 days are available, so the fund reports $1,150,000 of revenue; the $150,000 collected in September is reported as a deferred inflow of resources (unavailable revenue) and becomes a reconciling item. The $900,000 fund answer ignores the availability period. The $1,150,000 government-wide answer applies the availability criterion to the accrual basis. Reporting $1,300,000 in the fund ignores availability altogether.
questions.explanationJa: 償還型補助金は、適格な費用が発生した時点で受給資格要件が満たされるため、発生主義の政府活動の列では $1,300,000 全額を収益認識する。修正発生主義のファンドでは、これに加えて資源が利用可能であることが必要である。期中回収 $900,000 と期末後60日以内の回収 $250,000 は利用可能なので、ファンドの収益は $1,150,000。9月回収予定の $150,000 は繰延資源流入（利用不能収益）とし、調整項目となる。ファンドを $900,000 とするのは利用可能期間を無視した誤り、政府全体を $1,150,000 とするのは発生主義に利用可能性の要件を当てはめた誤り、ファンドを $1,300,000 とするのは利用可能性の要件を全く考慮しない誤りである。

questions.subtopic: Assigned Fund Balance — Encumbrances by Resource Source
questions.stem:
At June 30, Year 5, the General Fund of the City of Vance reports the following:
Outstanding encumbrances for road resurfacing financed by a state highway grant restricted to that purpose | $180,000
Outstanding encumbrances for general operating supplies, approved by the finance director under authority delegated by council policy | $240,000
Portion of existing fund balance appropriated in the Year 6 budget to eliminate a projected deficit | $600,000
Amount set aside by council resolution, which can be removed only by another council resolution, for a future municipal building | $1,000,000
Amount the finance director designated for computer replacement under the same delegated authority | $150,000
Supplies inventory | $90,000
What amount should the city report as assigned fund balance in the General Fund?
questions.explanation: Encumbrances are not a separate fund balance classification; they are reported within the classification of the resources that will be used to pay them. The $180,000 encumbrance funded by restricted grant resources is therefore part of restricted fund balance. The $240,000 encumbrance for general supplies reflects an intended use expressed by an official with delegated authority, so it is assigned. Appropriating existing fund balance to cover a deficit in the next year's budget ($600,000) is also assigned, as is the finance director's $150,000 designation. Assigned fund balance = $240,000 + $600,000 + $150,000 = $990,000. The council resolution amount is committed, and the inventory is nonspendable. The $1,170,000 answer places the restricted-resource encumbrance in assigned. The $390,000 answer omits the budget appropriation of fund balance. The $1,990,000 answer adds the committed amount.
questions.explanationJa: エンカンブランス（予算拘束）は独立したファンド残高区分ではなく、その支払に充てる資源の区分の中で報告する。制限付き補助金を財源とする $180,000 は制限付きファンド残高の一部となる。一般消耗品の $240,000 は権限委任を受けた職員が示した使用意図であり指定（assigned）となる。翌年度予算の赤字補填に既存のファンド残高を充当する $600,000 と、財務部長による $150,000 の指定も assigned である。assigned = $240,000 + $600,000 + $150,000 = $990,000。議会決議の金額は committed、棚卸資産は nonspendable である。$1,170,000 は制限付き資源のエンカンブランスを assigned に含めた誤り、$390,000 は予算でのファンド残高充当を含めなかった誤り、$1,990,000 は committed の金額を加えた誤りである。

questions.subtopic: Fund Balance — Residual Amount in a Special Revenue Fund
questions.stem:
At year-end, the Library Special Revenue Fund of the City of Wexford reports total fund balance of $1,400,000, consisting of the following:
Book and supplies inventory | $50,000
Amounts restricted by a private grantor for children's programs | $600,000
Amounts committed by council ordinance for branch renovations | $300,000
Remaining fund balance with no external or council constraints | $450,000
What amount should the city report as unassigned fund balance in the Library Special Revenue Fund?
questions.explanation: The General Fund is the only fund that reports a positive unassigned fund balance. In any other governmental fund, resources are, by the act of reporting them in that fund, at least assigned to the fund's purpose, so the remaining $450,000 is reported as assigned fund balance, and unassigned fund balance is $0. Another governmental fund reports unassigned fund balance only when it is negative, because expenditures exceed the amounts restricted, committed, and assigned. The $450,000 answer treats the residual as unassigned as it would be in the General Fund, the $500,000 answer also adds the nonspendable inventory, and the $750,000 answer adds the committed amount.
questions.explanationJa: 正の unassigned ファンド残高を報告するのは一般基金だけである。その他の政府ファンドでは、そのファンドで報告していること自体によって資源が少なくともファンドの目的に指定されているとみなされるため、残りの $450,000 は assigned となり、unassigned は $0 である。一般基金以外の政府ファンドが unassigned を報告するのは、支出が制限・拘束・指定の合計を超えて負の残高となる場合だけである。$450,000 は一般基金と同様に残額を unassigned とした誤り、$500,000 はさらに nonspendable の棚卸資産を加えた誤り、$750,000 は committed の金額を加えた誤りである。

questions.subtopic: Proprietary Fund Cash Flows — Investing Activities
questions.stem:
During the year, the Electric Enterprise Fund of the City of Yarrow had the following cash transactions:
Purchase of investment securities | $2,000,000
Proceeds from maturities of investment securities | $1,500,000
Interest and dividends received on investments | $140,000
Interest paid on revenue bonds issued to build a substation | $300,000
Purchase of distribution equipment | $400,000
What amount should the fund report as net cash provided by (used in) investing activities in its statement of cash flows?
questions.explanation: Under GASB, investing activities include acquiring and disposing of investments and collecting interest and dividends on them: $(2,000,000) + $1,500,000 + $140,000 = $(360,000). Unlike FASB, GASB classifies interest received as investing and places the purchase of capital assets, and the interest paid on debt issued to acquire them, in capital and related financing activities. The $(760,000) answer includes the equipment purchase as investing, as FASB would. The $(500,000) answer excludes the interest received, as if it were operating. The $(660,000) answer includes the interest paid on the revenue bonds.
questions.explanationJa: GASBでは、投資活動に投資の取得・処分とその利息・配当の受取が含まれる。$(2,000,000) + $1,500,000 + $140,000 = $(360,000)。FASBと異なり、GASBは受取利息を投資活動に区分し、資本資産の購入とその取得のための債務の支払利息は資本関連財務活動に区分する。$(760,000) はFASBのように設備購入を投資活動に含めた誤り、$(500,000) は受取利息を営業活動とみなして除外した誤り、$(660,000) は収益債の支払利息を含めた誤りである。

questions.subtopic: Proprietary Fund Cash Flows — Capital vs Noncapital Transfers and Taxes
questions.stem:
During the year, the Transit Enterprise Fund of the City of Ashby had the following cash transactions:
Transfer in from the General Fund to subsidize operations | $600,000
Transfer in from the General Fund designated by ordinance for construction of a new bus maintenance garage | $900,000
Proceeds of a short-term bank loan used to meet payroll | $300,000
Repayment of the short-term bank loan | $300,000
Interest paid on the short-term bank loan | $12,000
Property taxes received that are legally restricted to debt service on bonds issued to purchase buses | $400,000
State grant received to fund operating costs | $250,000
Transfer out to the General Fund | $150,000
What amount should the fund report as net cash provided by noncapital financing activities?
questions.explanation: Noncapital financing activities include operating subsidies and transfers, operating grants, and borrowing and repaying amounts that are not clearly attributable to capital purposes, together with the related interest. Net cash provided = $600,000 + $300,000 - $300,000 - $12,000 + $250,000 - $150,000 = $688,000. The $900,000 transfer designated for construction and the $400,000 of property taxes restricted to capital debt service are clearly attributable to capital purposes, so they are capital and related financing activities. The $1,588,000 answer includes the capital-designated transfer, the $1,088,000 answer includes the restricted property taxes, and the $700,000 answer excludes the interest on the noncapital loan, which GASB places in noncapital financing rather than in operating activities.
questions.explanationJa: 非資本財務活動には、営業補助のための移転・繰入、運営補助金、資本目的に明確に帰属しない借入・返済とその利息が含まれる。純キャッシュ = $600,000 + $300,000 − $300,000 − $12,000 + $250,000 − $150,000 = $688,000。建設用に指定された $900,000 の繰入と、資本関連債務の返済に法的に制限された固定資産税 $400,000 は資本目的に明確に帰属するため、資本関連財務活動となる。$1,588,000 は資本目的の繰入を含めた誤り、$1,088,000 は制限付き固定資産税を含めた誤り、$700,000 は非資本借入の利息を除外した誤りで、GASBではこの利息は営業活動ではなく非資本財務活動に区分する。

questions.subtopic: Proprietary Fund Cash Flows — Required Method
questions.stem: Which of the following correctly describes how cash flows from operating activities must be presented in the statement of cash flows of an enterprise fund under GASB standards?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Either the direct or the indirect method may be used, and a reconciliation is required only if the direct method is used

choices.label: B
choices.text: The direct method is required, along with a reconciliation of operating income to net cash provided by operating activities

choices.label: C
choices.text: The indirect method is required, beginning with the change in net position

choices.label: D
choices.text: The direct method is required, and no reconciliation of operating income is presented

questions.explanation: GASB 34 requires proprietary funds to present cash flows from operating activities using the direct method, showing major classes of receipts and payments, and to include a reconciliation of operating income to net cash provided by (used in) operating activities. The choice between methods and the reconciliation rule tied to the direct method describe FASB practice, not GASB. The indirect method is not permitted for the operating section, and under GASB any reconciliation starts from operating income rather than from the change in net position.
questions.explanationJa: GASB 34 は、プロプライエタリ・ファンドに対し、営業活動のキャッシュ・フローを直接法（主要な収入・支出の区分を表示）で表示し、営業利益から営業活動による純キャッシュへの調整表を併せて示すことを求めている。方法の選択や直接法採用時の調整表に関するルールはFASBの実務であり、GASBではない。営業活動区分に間接法は認められず、GASBの調整表は純資産の変動額ではなく営業利益から始まる。

questions.subtopic: Internal Service Funds — Presentation in Fund Statements
questions.stem: A county operates three internal service funds: fleet management, information technology, and self-insurance. How should these funds be reported in the county's fund financial statements?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Combined in a single column on the face of the proprietary fund statements, to the right of the total enterprise funds column

choices.label: B
choices.text: Each internal service fund that meets the major fund criteria in its own column on the face of the proprietary fund statements

choices.label: C
choices.text: In the governmental funds statements, because they primarily serve governmental departments

choices.label: D
choices.text: Excluded from the fund financial statements and reported only in the government-wide statements

questions.explanation: Internal service funds are proprietary funds, so they are reported in the proprietary fund statements using the economic resources focus and the accrual basis. Major fund reporting does not apply to internal service funds; all of them are aggregated in a single column on the face of the proprietary fund statements, separate from and to the right of the total enterprise funds column. Major fund criteria apply only to governmental and enterprise funds. The fact that internal service funds primarily serve governmental departments affects only how their balances are included in the government-wide governmental activities column; it does not move them into the governmental funds statements. They are not excluded from the fund statements.
questions.explanationJa: 内部サービス基金はプロプライエタリ・ファンドであり、経済的資源測定・発生主義によってプロプライエタリ・ファンドの財務諸表に報告する。主要ファンド報告は内部サービス基金には適用されず、全ての内部サービス基金をプロプライエタリ・ファンド財務諸表の本表に1列で合算し、企業基金合計列とは区別してその右側に表示する。主要ファンドの判定基準は政府ファンドと企業基金にのみ適用される。主に政府部門にサービスを提供するという事実は、政府全体の財務諸表で政府活動の列に含める扱いに影響するだけで、政府ファンドの財務諸表に移すことにはならない。ファンド財務諸表から除外されることもない。

questions.subtopic: Derived Tax Revenue — Modified Accrual vs Accrual
questions.stem:
The City of Bramley has a December 31 year-end and considers revenues available if they are collected within 60 days after year-end. The state collects a local sales tax on the city's behalf and remits it to the city. Sales taxes arising from Year 1 retail sales were received by the city as follows:
Received during Year 1 (January through October sales) | $4,600,000
Received January 15, Year 2 (November sales) | $420,000
Received February 15, Year 2 (December sales) | $450,000
Received April 30, Year 2 (state audit settlement of Year 1 sales) | $380,000
What amount of sales tax revenue should the city report for Year 1 in its General Fund and in the governmental activities column of the statement of activities?

choices.label: A
choices.text: General Fund $4,600,000; governmental activities $5,850,000

choices.label: B
choices.text: General Fund $5,850,000; governmental activities $5,850,000

choices.label: C
choices.text: General Fund $5,470,000; governmental activities $5,850,000

choices.label: D
choices.text: General Fund $5,470,000; governmental activities $5,470,000

questions.explanation: Sales taxes are derived tax revenues, recognized in the period in which the underlying exchange transaction (the retail sale) occurs. Under the accrual basis, the governmental activities column recognizes all $5,850,000 of Year 1 sales taxes ($4,600,000 + $420,000 + $450,000 + $380,000). Under the modified accrual basis, the General Fund also requires availability: the amounts collected within 60 days (January 15 and February 15) qualify, so fund revenue is $4,600,000 + $420,000 + $450,000 = $5,470,000. The $380,000 received in April is a deferred inflow of resources in the fund. The $4,600,000 fund answer recognizes only cash received during the year. Reporting $5,850,000 in the fund ignores availability, and reporting $5,470,000 in the governmental activities column applies the availability test to the accrual basis.
questions.explanationJa: 売上税は派生税収益であり、原因となる交換取引（小売販売）が発生した期に認識する。発生主義の政府活動の列では、Year 1 の売上税 $5,850,000（$4,600,000 + $420,000 + $450,000 + $380,000）を全額認識する。修正発生主義の一般基金では利用可能性も必要で、60日以内（1月15日・2月15日）の回収分が該当するため、ファンドの収益は $4,600,000 + $420,000 + $450,000 = $5,470,000。4月受領の $380,000 はファンドでは繰延資源流入となる。一般基金を $4,600,000 とするのは期中の現金受領分のみを認識した誤り、一般基金を $5,850,000 とするのは利用可能性を無視した誤り、政府活動を $5,470,000 とするのは発生主義に利用可能性の要件を当てはめた誤りである。

questions.subtopic: Debt Service Fund — Expenditures vs Other Financing Uses
questions.stem:
For the year ended June 30, Year 8, the Debt Service Fund of the City of Carver had the following:
Bond principal that matured and was paid | $800,000
Interest that came due and was paid | $360,000
Interest accrued from the last payment date to June 30 (next payment due December 1) | $90,000
Fees paid to the fiscal agent | $15,000
Payment to a refunded bond escrow agent from the proceeds of $5,000,000 of refunding bonds | $4,900,000
What amount should the Debt Service Fund report as total expenditures for the year?
questions.explanation: Under the modified accrual basis, principal and interest on general long-term debt are generally recognized as expenditures when due. Expenditures = $800,000 principal + $360,000 interest + $15,000 fiscal agent fees = $1,175,000. The $90,000 of interest that is not due until December 1 is not an expenditure in Year 8. In a refunding, the payment to the escrow agent made from the refunding bond proceeds is reported as an other financing use (payment to refunded bond escrow agent), not as an expenditure. The $1,265,000 answer accrues the interest that is not yet due, as the accrual basis would. The $6,075,000 answer treats the escrow payment as an expenditure. The $375,000 answer omits the principal payment, as if it were only a reduction of a liability.
questions.explanationJa: 修正発生主義では、一般長期債務の元利金は原則として支払期日到来時に支出として認識する。支出 = 元本 $800,000 + 利息 $360,000 + 支払代理人手数料 $15,000 = $1,175,000。12月1日まで支払期日が来ない利息 $90,000 は Year 8 の支出とならない。借換において、借換債の調達資金からエスクロー代理人へ支払う額は支出ではなく、その他の財源使用（借換対象債券エスクロー代理人への支払）として報告する。$1,265,000 は発生主義のように期日未到来の利息を計上した誤り、$6,075,000 はエスクローへの支払を支出とした誤り、$375,000 は元本返済を負債の減少にすぎないとみなして除外した誤りである。

questions.subtopic: Custodial Fund — Change in Fiduciary Net Position
questions.stem: Dalton County collects property taxes on behalf of several independent school districts and reports the activity in a custodial fund. Under the state distribution schedule, the county normally holds collections for more than three months before remitting them. During the year, the county collected $50,000,000 of school district taxes, distributed $47,000,000 to the districts, and transferred a $500,000 administrative fee to the county's General Fund as permitted by state law. At year-end, none of the remaining collections had become due to the school districts under the distribution schedule. What amount should the county report as the change in fiduciary net position of the custodial fund for the year?
questions.explanation: Under GASB 84, custodial funds present a statement of fiduciary net position and a statement of changes in fiduciary net position. A liability to the beneficiaries is recognized only when an event has occurred that compels the government to disburse the resources, such as an amount becoming due; until then, resources held are fiduciary net position. Additions of $50,000,000 less deductions of $47,000,000 distributed to the districts and $500,000 of administrative fees paid to the county = $2,500,000. The $0 answer reflects the former agency fund model, in which assets always equaled liabilities. The $3,000,000 answer omits the administrative fee deduction. The $50,000,000 answer reports total additions only.
questions.explanationJa: GASB 84 では、カストディアル・ファンドは受託純資産計算書と受託純資産変動計算書を作成する。受益者への負債は、支払期日の到来など政府に支払を強制する事象が生じた時点でのみ認識し、それまで保有する資源は受託純資産となる。増加 $50,000,000 から、学区への分配 $47,000,000 と郡への管理手数料 $500,000 の減少を差し引き $2,500,000。$0 は資産と負債が常に等しかった旧エージェンシー・ファンドの考え方による誤り、$3,000,000 は管理手数料の減少を除外した誤り、$50,000,000 は増加総額のみを報告した誤りである。

questions.subtopic: Governmental Fund Balance Sheet — Deferred Inflows vs Liabilities
questions.stem:
At December 31, Year 3, the General Fund of the City of Elton has the following items:
Property taxes levied in Year 3 to finance Year 4 operations and collected in December, Year 3 | $300,000
Cash advanced by the state under a reimbursement grant before any allowable costs were incurred | $200,000
Traffic fines assessed in Year 3 that are not expected to be collected within the city's availability period | $80,000
Cash received in Year 3 from a private donor restricted to youth programs, with no time requirement or other eligibility requirements | $150,000
What amounts should the General Fund report as deferred inflows of resources and as liabilities for these items in its balance sheet?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Deferred inflows $380,000; liabilities $200,000

choices.label: B
choices.text: Deferred inflows $580,000; liabilities $0

choices.label: C
choices.text: Deferred inflows $530,000; liabilities $200,000

choices.label: D
choices.text: Deferred inflows $80,000; liabilities $500,000

questions.explanation: Property taxes received before the period for which they are levied have not met the time requirement and are reported as a deferred inflow of resources ($300,000). Fines that are measurable but not available are unavailable revenue, also a deferred inflow ($80,000). Total deferred inflows = $380,000. Cash advanced under a reimbursement grant before eligibility requirements are met is a liability (unearned revenue) of $200,000, because the city must incur allowable costs to be entitled to the resources. The donor's purpose restriction does not delay recognition, so the $150,000 is revenue. The $580,000 answer reports the grant advance as a deferred inflow. The $530,000 answer also defers the purpose-restricted gift. The answer with $80,000 of deferred inflows and $500,000 of liabilities reports the advance property taxes as a liability rather than a deferred inflow.
questions.explanationJa: 課税対象期間より前に受領した固定資産税は時期要件を満たしていないため、繰延資源流入（$300,000）となる。測定可能だが利用可能でない罰金は利用不能収益であり、これも繰延資源流入（$80,000）。繰延資源流入合計 = $380,000。償還型補助金で受給資格要件を満たす前に前受けした現金は、適格費用を発生させなければ資源を受け取る権利がないため、負債（前受収益）$200,000 となる。寄付者による使途制限は認識を遅らせないため、$150,000 は収益である。$580,000 は補助金の前受けを繰延資源流入とした誤り、$530,000 はさらに使途制限付き寄付も繰り延べた誤り、繰延資源流入 $80,000・負債 $500,000 は前受けの固定資産税を繰延資源流入ではなく負債とした誤りである。

questions.subtopic: Fund Balance Classifications — Hierarchy
questions.stem: Which of the following lists the GASB 54 fund balance classifications in order from the most binding constraint to the least binding constraint?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Restricted, nonspendable, committed, assigned, unassigned

choices.label: B
choices.text: Nonspendable, committed, restricted, assigned, unassigned

choices.label: C
choices.text: Nonspendable, restricted, committed, assigned, unassigned

choices.label: D
choices.text: Nonspendable, restricted, assigned, committed, unassigned

questions.explanation: GASB 54 classifies fund balance by the relative strength of the constraints on spending. Nonspendable amounts cannot be spent at all because of their form or a requirement to be maintained intact. Restricted amounts are constrained by external parties or enabling legislation. Committed amounts are constrained by formal action of the government's highest level of decision-making authority. Assigned amounts reflect intended use expressed by the governing body or an authorized official. Unassigned is the residual. Placing restricted before nonspendable ignores that nonspendable resources cannot be spent at all. Placing committed before restricted ranks the government's self-imposed constraint above external constraints. Placing assigned before committed ranks intent above formal action of the governing body.
questions.explanationJa: GASB 54 は、支出に対する制約の強さに応じてファンド残高を区分する。nonspendable は形態上、または元本維持の要求により全く支出できない金額。restricted は外部当事者または授権立法による制約。committed は政府の最高意思決定機関の正式な行為による制約。assigned は議会または権限ある職員が示した使用意図。unassigned は残余である。restricted を nonspendable より前に置く順序は、nonspendable が全く支出できないことを無視している。committed を restricted より前に置く順序は、政府自身が課した制約を外部制約より上位にしている。assigned を committed より前に置く順序は、意図を議会の正式な行為より上位にしている。

questions.subtopic: Enterprise Fund Net Position — Council-Imposed Constraints
questions.stem: The city council of Fenwick adopted a resolution setting aside $2,000,000 of the Water Enterprise Fund's cash and investments for a future treatment plant expansion. The resources are not subject to any bond covenant, grant agreement, or enabling legislation. How should the $2,000,000 be reported in the enterprise fund's statement of net position?

choices.label: A
choices.text: As restricted net position, because the governing body has formally set the resources aside

choices.label: B
choices.text: As committed fund balance, because the constraint was imposed by the highest level of decision-making authority

choices.label: C
choices.text: As net investment in capital assets, because the resources will be used for a capital asset

choices.label: D
choices.text: As part of unrestricted net position

questions.explanation: Proprietary funds report net position in three components: net investment in capital assets, restricted, and unrestricted. Restricted net position requires constraints imposed externally (by creditors, grantors, contributors, or laws of other governments) or by enabling legislation. A council resolution is a constraint the government imposes on itself, so the $2,000,000 remains unrestricted net position; the government may disclose the designation in the notes. Committed is a fund balance classification used only by governmental funds. Net investment in capital assets includes only capital assets net of related debt, not cash set aside for future capital spending.
questions.explanationJa: プロプライエタリ・ファンドは純資産を、資本資産純投資額、制限付き、制限なしの3区分で報告する。制限付き純資産とするには、外部（債権者、補助金交付者、寄付者、他の政府の法令）または授権立法による制約が必要である。議会の決議は政府自身が課した制約なので、$2,000,000 は制限なし純資産のままであり、指定の事実は注記で開示できる。committed は政府ファンドだけが用いるファンド残高の区分である。資本資産純投資額に含まれるのは関連債務控除後の資本資産のみで、将来の資本的支出のために取り置いた現金は含まれない。
